verdict.rationale: Aliases and masked addresses are a fair axis for an email app, so the story applies to Zero. Nothing in the evidence shows Zero creating aliases, forwarding addresses or masked addresses. The 'does not track, collect, or sell your data' claim is a separate data-handling privacy statement and does not hide the user's address from sign-ups or strangers.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can use aliases or masked addresses so sign-ups and strangers never learn my real address
